PROJECTSIMPEDANCE - Nference Labs Private LimitedDeveloped a next-generation, impedance-based cardiac mapping system (EAM), revolutionizing catheter guidance byeliminating dependence on proprietary magnetic systems—significantly reducing both cost and system complexity.

System Architecture & Real-Time Data Processing: Designed and implemented a high-performance data acquisition andprocessing pipeline with near-zero latency, ensuring seamless real-time communication between hardware and softwarewhile optimizing storage efficiency without impacting runtime.

Machine Learning & Algorithm Optimization: Leveraged advanced machine learning techniques to enhance the accuracyand efficiency of electro-anatomical maps, refining signal processing methodologies and boosting diagnostic precision.

Performance & Accuracy: Achieved an industry-leading root mean square error (RMSE) of ~2mm compared to traditionalmagnetic mapping techniques, validating the system’s reliability for precise cardiac diagnostics.

Innovation & Cost Reduction: Pioneered an alternative to expensive and proprietary magnetic systems, making cardiacmapping more accessible while maintaining clinical-grade accuracy, positioning the system as a cost-effective solution inelectrophysiology.This role required deep expertise in real-time signal processing, medical imaging, and machine learning, coupled with strongproblem-solving and system design skills to push the boundaries of cardiac electrophysiology.SIG-ID - Nference Labs Private LimitedDesigned and implemented a deep learning-based system for identifying Pulmonary Vein Potential (PVP) signatures in ECGsignals, addressing the critical challenge of distinguishing between visually similar patterns, such as pacing spikes and otherrecurrent but random signals.

Advanced Signal Processing & Pattern Recognition: Developed a robust framework to accurately detect PVP signatures,overcoming noise and signal overlap that traditionally hinder precise arrhythmia mapping.

Deep Learning Implementation: Leveraged UNET-1D, a specialized deep learning architecture for one-dimensional signalsegmentation, to precisely isolate and classify PVPs from complex ECG waveforms.

High-Accuracy Performance: Achieved an exceptional 98% classification accuracy, significantly enhancing the reliability ofarrhythmia diagnostics and improving outcomes in electrophysiological procedures.

Impact on Electrophysiology: Improved the precision of PVP detection, enabling more effective pulmonary vein isolation(PVI) procedures—critical in the treatment of atrial fibrillation and other arrhythmias.This project combined deep learning, biomedical signal processing, and domain-specific expertise to advance the accuracyand effectiveness of ECG-based arrhythmia diagnostics.NEUVIZ - Nference Labs Private LimitedDesigned and enhanced a post-procedural analysis tool for electro-anatomical mapping, providing physicians with advancedvisualization and data-driven insights to improve follow-up treatment strategies and patient outcomes.

Seamless Data Integration & Visualization: Developed a robust system to load, process, and visualize electro-anatomicalmaps from both proprietary and third-party mapping systems, enabling direct side-by-side comparisons for enhancedprocedural assessment.

Advanced Metrics & Clinical Insights: Augmented existing data with additional computed metrics, offering clinicians adeeper understanding of cardiac geometry, lesion effectiveness, and procedural outcomes beyond the raw mapping data.

Enhanced Decision Support: Enabled physicians to retrospectively analyze historical procedure data, facilitating better-informed decisions for follow-up treatments and refinement of ablation strategies.

Impact on Electrophysiology Workflow: Improved accessibility and interpretability of electro-anatomical data, reducingreliance on fragmented or incomplete records and enhancing continuity of care in electrophysiology procedures.This tool significantly advanced post-procedural evaluation by integrating multi-source data and providing novel insights,ultimately helping physicians optimize treatment plans for better patient outcomes.DYNAMIC BENCHMARKING - Statestreet CorporationDeveloped a dynamic benchmarking model to enhance the predictive accuracy of fund and securities valuation by analyzinghistorical relationships with market indices.

Feature Selection & Model Optimization: Addressed the challenge of selecting the most relevant indices from a dataset ofover 5,000 options by leveraging Lasso regression for feature selection, effectively isolating the top 50 indices with thehighest impact on fund movements.

Predictive Modeling for Fund Valuation: Built and deployed a high-performance predictive model capable of estimatingfund and security values with superior accuracy, significantly improving risk assessment and financial decision-making.

Production Deployment & Business Impact: Successfully deployed the model in a production environment, where it hasoutperformed the business benchmark in over 70% of cases, enhancing fund performance predictions and valuationreliability.

Strategic Financial Insights: Provided asset managers with a data-driven approach to assess fund performance, leading tomore informed investment strategies and risk mitigation.This solution optimized fund valuation processes, leveraging machine learning to drive better financial insights and improvedecision-making in asset management.WAREHOUSE PPE DETECTION - Dimaag AI Private LimitedDeveloped an AI-driven PPE Detection system for a Japanese manufacturing client, enhancing workplace safety by ensuringcompliance with protective equipment requirements through real-time CCTV monitoring.

Computer Vision for Workplace Safety: Designed and implemented a robust object detection model to identify essentialpersonal protective equipment (PPE)—including vests, goggles, gloves, and hard hats—using warehouse surveillancefootage.

Optimized Deep Learning Model: Leveraged Tiny YOLOv4, a lightweight yet high-performance object detection model, toachieve efficient real-time inference with an average per-class accuracy of 95% on client-specific data.

Scalable & Reusable AI Components: Developed modular, reusable components to streamline the training anddeployment of custom object detection models, enabling rapid adaptation to new PPE requirements with minimalmanual intervention.

Impact on Workplace Safety & Compliance: Provided a scalable, AI-powered solution that improved monitoring efficiency,reduced compliance violations, and ensured a safer working environment for warehouse employees.

PROJECTSBALL GRID ARRAY - Dimaag AI Private LimitedDeveloped an advanced BGA Transfer system for a leading chip fabrication client, ensuring precise and reliable solder balltransfers while maintaining critical semiconductor manufacturing parameters.

High-Precision Image Processing: Designed and implemented a robust solution to analyze high-resolution 3D ball gridarray (BGA) images, leveraging traditional image processing techniques to accurately detect, segment, and track individualsolder balls.

Advanced Image Blending for Seamless Integration: Applied Poisson Blending, a sophisticated image fusion technique, toseamlessly integrate transferred solder balls into the target grid, preserving both structural integrity and electricalproperties.

End-to-End Solution Architecture & Implementation: Led the entire solution design, collaborating closely with the client todefine requirements, validate outputs, and ensure compliance with stringent semiconductor industry standards.Independently implemented and optimized the solution for accuracy, efficiency, and reliability.

Impact on Semiconductor Manufacturing: Delivered a high-precision system that ensured minimal deviation in keyparameters—including noise profile, brightness, volume, and size—significantly enhancing chip fabrication quality andconsistency.This project showcased expertise in image processing, computer vision, and semiconductor manufacturing, delivering acutting-edge solution that met the industry's rigorous precision standards.COGNITIVE IMAGE PROCESSING/DEEP EXTRACTION FRAMEWORK FOR TEXT(CIP/DEFT) and XAI - Wipro LimitedDesigned and developed an intelligent invoice processing pipeline and contributed to Wipro’s proprietary Explainable AI (XAI)solution, enhancing automation and interpretability in AI-driven decision-making.

Automated Invoice Processing: Built an advanced pipeline to extract key financial entities—including Total Amount, GST,Vendor ID, Date, and Address—from both image-based and text-based PDFs.

OCR & NER Implementation: Integrated preprocessing techniques, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and a NamedEntity Recognition (NER) model, achieving 85–90% OCR accuracy and 95% NER accuracy for precise data extraction.

Contribution to Explainable AI (XAI): Played a key role in Wipro’s E.T.H.I.C.A (Explainable AI) initiative by designing thesupporting database architecture and defining key metrics to evaluate Explainability, Transparency, Human-CentricDesign, Interpretability, Common Sense, and Auditability.

Business Impact: Enhanced financial document automation, reducing manual effort in invoice processing while ensuringcompliance and auditability through explainable AI frameworks.This work demonstrated expertise in NLP, OCR, and explainable AI, driving automation and transparency in enterprise AIsolutions.MATERIALL - RECOMMENDATION ENGINE - AmberTag Analytics Private LimitedDeveloped a scalable recommendation system for Materiall, a fashion e-commerce client, by integrating deep learning anddata engineering techniques to enhance product discovery and personalization.Project Scope & Challenges:The project aimed to streamline product recommendations by leveraging multiple data sources, ensuring a structured andconsistent dataset for model training. The primary challenges included:1.Populating Product Feeds: Many items lacked recommendations due to incomplete metadata. To address this, an imageclassification pipeline was developed to automatically categorize and label products.2.Fetching Similar Products: Extracted visual attributes from images using deep learning models to recommend visuallysimilar products, enhancing customer engagement and personalization.Deep Learning Model Development & Implementation

Designed and trained four deep learning models for attribute extraction and image classification, achieving 85–90% testaccuracy across different fashion attributes.

Optimized model architectures for efficiency, ensuring real-time performance in a production environment.

Integrated structured and unstructured data sources (images, metadata, and customer interactions) to refinerecommendations.Deployment & Business Impact

Built a minimalistic CLI-based recommendation system, enabling quick retrieval of similar products and category-basedsuggestions.

Successfully delivered one of AmberTAG’s first major deep learning client projects, setting a foundation for future AI-driveninitiatives in fashion e-commerce.

Improved recommendation accuracy, leading to better product visibility and enhanced customer experience, ultimatelydriving higher engagement and potential sales growth.

sections.text:
PROJECTSIMPEDANCE - Nference Labs Private LimitedDeveloped a next-generation, impedance-based cardiac mapping system (EAM), revolutionizing catheter guidance byeliminating dependence on proprietary magnetic systems—significantly reducing both cost and system complexity.
System Architecture & Real-Time Data Processing: Designed and implemented a high-performance data acquisition andprocessing pipeline with near-zero latency, ensuring seamless real-time communication between hardware and softwarewhile optimizing storage efficiency without impacting runtime.
Machine Learning & Algorithm Optimization: Leveraged advanced machine learning techniques to enhance the accuracyand efficiency of electro-anatomical maps, refining signal processing methodologies and boosting diagnostic precision.
Performance & Accuracy: Achieved an industry-leading root mean square error (RMSE) of ~2mm compared to traditionalmagnetic mapping techniques, validating the system’s reliability for precise cardiac diagnostics.
Innovation & Cost Reduction: Pioneered an alternative to expensive and proprietary magnetic systems, making cardiacmapping more accessible while maintaining clinical-grade accuracy, positioning the system as a cost-effective solution inelectrophysiology.This role required deep expertise in real-time signal processing, medical imaging, and machine learning, coupled with strongproblem-solving and system design skills to push the boundaries of cardiac electrophysiology.SIG-ID - Nference Labs Private LimitedDesigned and implemented a deep learning-based system for identifying Pulmonary Vein Potential (PVP) signatures in ECGsignals, addressing the critical challenge of distinguishing between visually similar patterns, such as pacing spikes and otherrecurrent but random signals.
Advanced Signal Processing & Pattern Recognition: Developed a robust framework to accurately detect PVP signatures,overcoming noise and signal overlap that traditionally hinder precise arrhythmia mapping.
Deep Learning Implementation: Leveraged UNET-1D, a specialized deep learning architecture for one-dimensional signalsegmentation, to precisely isolate and classify PVPs from complex ECG waveforms.
High-Accuracy Performance: Achieved an exceptional 98% classification accuracy, significantly enhancing the reliability ofarrhythmia diagnostics and improving outcomes in electrophysiological procedures.
Impact on Electrophysiology: Improved the precision of PVP detection, enabling more effective pulmonary vein isolation(PVI) procedures—critical in the treatment of atrial fibrillation and other arrhythmias.This project combined deep learning, biomedical signal processing, and domain-specific expertise to advance the accuracyand effectiveness of ECG-based arrhythmia diagnostics.NEUVIZ - Nference Labs Private LimitedDesigned and enhanced a post-procedural analysis tool for electro-anatomical mapping, providing physicians with advancedvisualization and data-driven insights to improve follow-up treatment strategies and patient outcomes.
Seamless Data Integration & Visualization: Developed a robust system to load, process, and visualize electro-anatomicalmaps from both proprietary and third-party mapping systems, enabling direct side-by-side comparisons for enhancedprocedural assessment.
Advanced Metrics & Clinical Insights: Augmented existing data with additional computed metrics, offering clinicians adeeper understanding of cardiac geometry, lesion effectiveness, and procedural outcomes beyond the raw mapping data.
Enhanced Decision Support: Enabled physicians to retrospectively analyze historical procedure data, facilitating better-informed decisions for follow-up treatments and refinement of ablation strategies.
Impact on Electrophysiology Workflow: Improved accessibility and interpretability of electro-anatomical data, reducingreliance on fragmented or incomplete records and enhancing continuity of care in electrophysiology procedures.This tool significantly advanced post-procedural evaluation by integrating multi-source data and providing novel insights,ultimately helping physicians optimize treatment plans for better patient outcomes.DYNAMIC BENCHMARKING - Statestreet CorporationDeveloped a dynamic benchmarking model to enhance the predictive accuracy of fund and securities valuation by analyzinghistorical relationships with market indices.
Feature Selection & Model Optimization: Addressed the challenge of selecting the most relevant indices from a dataset ofover 5,000 options by leveraging Lasso regression for feature selection, effectively isolating the top 50 indices with thehighest impact on fund movements.
Predictive Modeling for Fund Valuation: Built and deployed a high-performance predictive model capable of estimatingfund and security values with superior accuracy, significantly improving risk assessment and financial decision-making.
Production Deployment & Business Impact: Successfully deployed the model in a production environment, where it hasoutperformed the business benchmark in over 70% of cases, enhancing fund performance predictions and valuationreliability.
Strategic Financial Insights: Provided asset managers with a data-driven approach to assess fund performance, leading tomore informed investment strategies and risk mitigation.This solution optimized fund valuation processes, leveraging machine learning to drive better financial insights and improvedecision-making in asset management.WAREHOUSE PPE DETECTION - Dimaag AI Private LimitedDeveloped an AI-driven PPE Detection system for a Japanese manufacturing client, enhancing workplace safety by ensuringcompliance with protective equipment requirements through real-time CCTV monitoring.
Computer Vision for Workplace Safety: Designed and implemented a robust object detection model to identify essentialpersonal protective equipment (PPE)—including vests, goggles, gloves, and hard hats—using warehouse surveillancefootage.
Optimized Deep Learning Model: Leveraged Tiny YOLOv4, a lightweight yet high-performance object detection model, toachieve efficient real-time inference with an average per-class accuracy of 95% on client-specific data.
Scalable & Reusable AI Components: Developed modular, reusable components to streamline the training anddeployment of custom object detection models, enabling rapid adaptation to new PPE requirements with minimalmanual intervention.
Impact on Workplace Safety & Compliance: Provided a scalable, AI-powered solution that improved monitoring efficiency,reduced compliance violations, and ensured a safer working environment for warehouse employees.
PROJECTSBALL GRID ARRAY - Dimaag AI Private LimitedDeveloped an advanced BGA Transfer system for a leading chip fabrication client, ensuring precise and reliable solder balltransfers while maintaining critical semiconductor manufacturing parameters.
High-Precision Image Processing: Designed and implemented a robust solution to analyze high-resolution 3D ball gridarray (BGA) images, leveraging traditional image processing techniques to accurately detect, segment, and track individualsolder balls.
Advanced Image Blending for Seamless Integration: Applied Poisson Blending, a sophisticated image fusion technique, toseamlessly integrate transferred solder balls into the target grid, preserving both structural integrity and electricalproperties.
End-to-End Solution Architecture & Implementation: Led the entire solution design, collaborating closely with the client todefine requirements, validate outputs, and ensure compliance with stringent semiconductor industry standards.Independently implemented and optimized the solution for accuracy, efficiency, and reliability.
Impact on Semiconductor Manufacturing: Delivered a high-precision system that ensured minimal deviation in keyparameters—including noise profile, brightness, volume, and size—significantly enhancing chip fabrication quality andconsistency.This project showcased expertise in image processing, computer vision, and semiconductor manufacturing, delivering acutting-edge solution that met the industry's rigorous precision standards.COGNITIVE IMAGE PROCESSING/DEEP EXTRACTION FRAMEWORK FOR TEXT(CIP/DEFT) and XAI - Wipro LimitedDesigned and developed an intelligent invoice processing pipeline and contributed to Wipro’s proprietary Explainable AI (XAI)solution, enhancing automation and interpretability in AI-driven decision-making.
Automated Invoice Processing: Built an advanced pipeline to extract key financial entities—including Total Amount, GST,Vendor ID, Date, and Address—from both image-based and text-based PDFs.
OCR & NER Implementation: Integrated preprocessing techniques, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and a NamedEntity Recognition (NER) model, achieving 85–90% OCR accuracy and 95% NER accuracy for precise data extraction.
Contribution to Explainable AI (XAI): Played a key role in Wipro’s E.T.H.I.C.A (Explainable AI) initiative by designing thesupporting database architecture and defining key metrics to evaluate Explainability, Transparency, Human-CentricDesign, Interpretability, Common Sense, and Auditability.
Business Impact: Enhanced financial document automation, reducing manual effort in invoice processing while ensuringcompliance and auditability through explainable AI frameworks.This work demonstrated expertise in NLP, OCR, and explainable AI, driving automation and transparency in enterprise AIsolutions.MATERIALL - RECOMMENDATION ENGINE - AmberTag Analytics Private LimitedDeveloped a scalable recommendation system for Materiall, a fashion e-commerce client, by integrating deep learning anddata engineering techniques to enhance product discovery and personalization.Project Scope & Challenges:The project aimed to streamline product recommendations by leveraging multiple data sources, ensuring a structured andconsistent dataset for model training. The primary challenges included:1.Populating Product Feeds: Many items lacked recommendations due to incomplete metadata. To address this, an imageclassification pipeline was developed to automatically categorize and label products.2.Fetching Similar Products: Extracted visual attributes from images using deep learning models to recommend visuallysimilar products, enhancing customer engagement and personalization.Deep Learning Model Development & Implementation
Designed and trained four deep learning models for attribute extraction and image classification, achieving 85–90% testaccuracy across different fashion attributes.
Optimized model architectures for efficiency, ensuring real-time performance in a production environment.
Integrated structured and unstructured data sources (images, metadata, and customer interactions) to refinerecommendations.Deployment & Business Impact
Built a minimalistic CLI-based recommendation system, enabling quick retrieval of similar products and category-basedsuggestions.
Successfully delivered one of AmberTAG’s first major deep learning client projects, setting a foundation for future AI-driveninitiatives in fashion e-commerce.
Improved recommendation accuracy, leading to better product visibility and enhanced customer experience, ultimatelydriving higher engagement and potential sales growth.

PROJECTSIMPEDANCE - Nference Labs Private LimitedDeveloped a next-generation, impedance-based cardiac mapping system (EAM), revolutionizing catheter guidance byeliminating dependence on proprietary magnetic systems—significantly reducing both cost and system complexity.
System Architecture & Real-Time Data Processing: Designed and implemented a high-performance data acquisition andprocessing pipeline with near-zero latency, ensuring seamless real-time communication between hardware and softwarewhile optimizing storage efficiency without impacting runtime.
Machine Learning & Algorithm Optimization: Leveraged advanced machine learning techniques to enhance the accuracyand efficiency of electro-anatomical maps, refining signal processing methodologies and boosting diagnostic precision.
Performance & Accuracy: Achieved an industry-leading root mean square error (RMSE) of ~2mm compared to traditionalmagnetic mapping techniques, validating the system’s reliability for precise cardiac diagnostics.
Innovation & Cost Reduction: Pioneered an alternative to expensive and proprietary magnetic systems, making cardiacmapping more accessible while maintaining clinical-grade accuracy, positioning the system as a cost-effective solution inelectrophysiology.This role required deep expertise in real-time signal processing, medical imaging, and machine learning, coupled with strongproblem-solving and system design skills to push the boundaries of cardiac electrophysiology.SIG-ID - Nference Labs Private LimitedDesigned and implemented a deep learning-based system for identifying Pulmonary Vein Potential (PVP) signatures in ECGsignals, addressing the critical challenge of distinguishing between visually similar patterns, such as pacing spikes and otherrecurrent but random signals.
Advanced Signal Processing & Pattern Recognition: Developed a robust framework to accurately detect PVP signatures,overcoming noise and signal overlap that traditionally hinder precise arrhythmia mapping.
Deep Learning Implementation: Leveraged UNET-1D, a specialized deep learning architecture for one-dimensional signalsegmentation, to precisely isolate and classify PVPs from complex ECG waveforms.
High-Accuracy Performance: Achieved an exceptional 98% classification accuracy, significantly enhancing the reliability ofarrhythmia diagnostics and improving outcomes in electrophysiological procedures.
Impact on Electrophysiology: Improved the precision of PVP detection, enabling more effective pulmonary vein isolation(PVI) procedures—critical in the treatment of atrial fibrillation and other arrhythmias.This project combined deep learning, biomedical signal processing, and domain-specific expertise to advance the accuracyand effectiveness of ECG-based arrhythmia diagnostics.NEUVIZ - Nference Labs Private LimitedDesigned and enhanced a post-procedural analysis tool for electro-anatomical mapping, providing physicians with advancedvisualization and data-driven insights to improve follow-up treatment strategies and patient outcomes.
Seamless Data Integration & Visualization: Developed a robust system to load, process, and visualize electro-anatomicalmaps from both proprietary and third-party mapping systems, enabling direct side-by-side comparisons for enhancedprocedural assessment.
Advanced Metrics & Clinical Insights: Augmented existing data with additional computed metrics, offering clinicians adeeper understanding of cardiac geometry, lesion effectiveness, and procedural outcomes beyond the raw mapping data.
Enhanced Decision Support: Enabled physicians to retrospectively analyze historical procedure data, facilitating better-informed decisions for follow-up treatments and refinement of ablation strategies.
Impact on Electrophysiology Workflow: Improved accessibility and interpretability of electro-anatomical data, reducingreliance on fragmented or incomplete records and enhancing continuity of care in electrophysiology procedures.This tool significantly advanced post-procedural evaluation by integrating multi-source data and providing novel insights,ultimately helping physicians optimize treatment plans for better patient outcomes.DYNAMIC BENCHMARKING - Statestreet CorporationDeveloped a dynamic benchmarking model to enhance the predictive accuracy of fund and securities valuation by analyzinghistorical relationships with market indices.
Feature Selection & Model Optimization: Addressed the challenge of selecting the most relevant indices from a dataset ofover 5,000 options by leveraging Lasso regression for feature selection, effectively isolating the top 50 indices with thehighest impact on fund movements.
Predictive Modeling for Fund Valuation: Built and deployed a high-performance predictive model capable of estimatingfund and security values with superior accuracy, significantly improving risk assessment and financial decision-making.
Production Deployment & Business Impact: Successfully deployed the model in a production environment, where it hasoutperformed the business benchmark in over 70% of cases, enhancing fund performance predictions and valuationreliability.
Strategic Financial Insights: Provided asset managers with a data-driven approach to assess fund performance, leading tomore informed investment strategies and risk mitigation.This solution optimized fund valuation processes, leveraging machine learning to drive better financial insights and improvedecision-making in asset management.WAREHOUSE PPE DETECTION - Dimaag AI Private LimitedDeveloped an AI-driven PPE Detection system for a Japanese manufacturing client, enhancing workplace safety by ensuringcompliance with protective equipment requirements through real-time CCTV monitoring.
Computer Vision for Workplace Safety: Designed and implemented a robust object detection model to identify essentialpersonal protective equipment (PPE)—including vests, goggles, gloves, and hard hats—using warehouse surveillancefootage.
Optimized Deep Learning Model: Leveraged Tiny YOLOv4, a lightweight yet high-performance object detection model, toachieve efficient real-time inference with an average per-class accuracy of 95% on client-specific data.
Scalable & Reusable AI Components: Developed modular, reusable components to streamline the training anddeployment of custom object detection models, enabling rapid adaptation to new PPE requirements with minimalmanual intervention.
Impact on Workplace Safety & Compliance: Provided a scalable, AI-powered solution that improved monitoring efficiency,reduced compliance violations, and ensured a safer working environment for warehouse employees.
PROJECTSBALL GRID ARRAY - Dimaag AI Private LimitedDeveloped an advanced BGA Transfer system for a leading chip fabrication client, ensuring precise and reliable solder balltransfers while maintaining critical semiconductor manufacturing parameters.
High-Precision Image Processing: Designed and implemented a robust solution to analyze high-resolution 3D ball gridarray (BGA) images, leveraging traditional image processing techniques to accurately detect, segment, and track individualsolder balls.
Advanced Image Blending for Seamless Integration: Applied Poisson Blending, a sophisticated image fusion technique, toseamlessly integrate transferred solder balls into the target grid, preserving both structural integrity and electricalproperties.
End-to-End Solution Architecture & Implementation: Led the entire solution design, collaborating closely with the client todefine requirements, validate outputs, and ensure compliance with stringent semiconductor industry standards.Independently implemented and optimized the solution for accuracy, efficiency, and reliability.
Impact on Semiconductor Manufacturing: Delivered a high-precision system that ensured minimal deviation in keyparameters—including noise profile, brightness, volume, and size—significantly enhancing chip fabrication quality andconsistency.This project showcased expertise in image processing, computer vision, and semiconductor manufacturing, delivering acutting-edge solution that met the industry's rigorous precision standards.COGNITIVE IMAGE PROCESSING/DEEP EXTRACTION FRAMEWORK FOR TEXT(CIP/DEFT) and XAI - Wipro LimitedDesigned and developed an intelligent invoice processing pipeline and contributed to Wipro’s proprietary Explainable AI (XAI)solution, enhancing automation and interpretability in AI-driven decision-making.
Automated Invoice Processing: Built an advanced pipeline to extract key financial entities—including Total Amount, GST,Vendor ID, Date, and Address—from both image-based and text-based PDFs.
OCR & NER Implementation: Integrated preprocessing techniques, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and a NamedEntity Recognition (NER) model, achieving 85–90% OCR accuracy and 95% NER accuracy for precise data extraction.
Contribution to Explainable AI (XAI): Played a key role in Wipro’s E.T.H.I.C.A (Explainable AI) initiative by designing thesupporting database architecture and defining key metrics to evaluate Explainability, Transparency, Human-CentricDesign, Interpretability, Common Sense, and Auditability.
Business Impact: Enhanced financial document automation, reducing manual effort in invoice processing while ensuringcompliance and auditability through explainable AI frameworks.This work demonstrated expertise in NLP, OCR, and explainable AI, driving automation and transparency in enterprise AIsolutions.MATERIALL - RECOMMENDATION ENGINE - AmberTag Analytics Private LimitedDeveloped a scalable recommendation system for Materiall, a fashion e-commerce client, by integrating deep learning anddata engineering techniques to enhance product discovery and personalization.Project Scope & Challenges:The project aimed to streamline product recommendations by leveraging multiple data sources, ensuring a structured andconsistent dataset for model training. The primary challenges included:1.Populating Product Feeds: Many items lacked recommendations due to incomplete metadata. To address this, an imageclassification pipeline was developed to automatically categorize and label products.2.Fetching Similar Products: Extracted visual attributes from images using deep learning models to recommend visuallysimilar products, enhancing customer engagement and personalization.Deep Learning Model Development & Implementation
Designed and trained four deep learning models for attribute extraction and image classification, achieving 85–90% testaccuracy across different fashion attributes.
Optimized model architectures for efficiency, ensuring real-time performance in a production environment.
Integrated structured and unstructured data sources (images, metadata, and customer interactions) to refinerecommendations.Deployment & Business Impact
Built a minimalistic CLI-based recommendation system, enabling quick retrieval of similar products and category-basedsuggestions.
Successfully delivered one of AmberTAG’s first major deep learning client projects, setting a foundation for future AI-driveninitiatives in fashion e-commerce.
Improved recommendation accuracy, leading to better product visibility and enhanced customer experience, ultimatelydriving higher engagement and potential sales growth.
